name: Editor Check: Game UI (Manual)
description: Roadmap 2026-10-05 STEP 2 §9: the Phase 11 screens a person judges in the Unity Editor. The tool starts the server on 127.0.0.1:7777 (the Editor's default address) with two headless rivals; you press Play in the Editor and connect. Each manualCheck pauses the run for PASS / FAIL (web UI, or p/f on a terminal). Statistics need the database: with Persistence off (the QA default) the window shows its 'unavailable' message, which is the expected result here.

steps.description: Press Play in the Unity Editor. Title screen: every Korean label is readable (no empty boxes), the address field shows 127.0.0.1 and the port 7777.
Type a Korean name (테스트) with the IME. While composing, the syllable shows inside the name field; after committing, the field holds exactly 테스트 (no leftover jamo, no doubled syllable).
Press Connect. The connecting screen shows, then the game. (Answer after you are in the game; the match starts 5 s after you join.)

The two rivals are visible as orange capsules (no name over their heads by design, Phase 11 D9: names show in the kill feed, the spectator line and the result). The POI name (top left) and the alive count (top centre) are readable.
Esc opens the menu (cursor free, the game stops reading mouse and keys); Esc again or 'continue' closes it and a click locks the cursor again.
F1 shows the debug lines (tick, ping, movement, build line) and F1 again hides them. The lines do not overlap the POI labels or the HUD.
The kill feed (top right) shows qa-rival1 eliminated, in Korean, and the line fades after about 6 s.
The result screen shows you in 1st place with your Korean name, and its buttons respond. (It stays 30 s, then the next lobby starts.)
Open 'my statistics' from the result screen or the menu. With the database off it shows the unavailable message (not an endless wait); Esc closes the window first, then the screen.
The game shows the disconnect screen with a Korean reason and a reconnect / title button (after the automatic reconnect attempts give up).
Press reconnect (or go to the title and connect again). You join the restarted server on 7777 and the lobby shows.
